1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1295|fe52f4ea.name: Lara Moore
1295|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1309|0624ab70.name: Wynne Larson
1309|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1309|23d8b931.name: Wynne Larson
1309|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1432|f33fbaea.name: Renato Gallina
1432|f33fbaea.text: Hey, miss.  You look like a $C with discerning tastes in wine.  I have a favor to ask, and I think I can make you an offer you can't refuse...forget about it!

14723|240f95e3.name: Mistina Steelshield
14723|240f95e3.text:
Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the dwarves of Ironforge, then you can start by donating valuable resources!  Ironforge finds itself running low on cloth piece; textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know!

Rather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the dwarven people of Ironforge!

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|6928abbf.name: John Burnside
2457|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

2489|6e89a35a.name: Milstaff Stormeye
2489|6e89a35a.text: As a $c, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

328|9c6df40b.name: Zaldimar Wefhellt
328|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

377|3df2cbb2.name: Priestess Josetta
377|3df2cbb2.text: Do not turn your back on the Light, $c, it may be the one thing that saves you some day.

5144|c2a278c1.name: Bink
5144|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

5145|c2a278c1.name: Juli Stormkettle
5145|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

5595|668273f0.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|668273f0.text: Flowers and seeds and such?  That would be Reyna Stonebranch's area of expertise.  Ye can find her tending to her plants over at the Ironforge Physician on the southern side of The Great Forge.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

68|e1cab2c5.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|e1cab2c5.text: There's a great cook who works at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town.  I've watched him use a knife when he cooks and just between you and me, I don't think he's always been a cook.  Don't get me wrong... if you still want to learn, he's the best we have.

7312|c2a278c1.name: Dink
7312|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

917|1fc2052d.name: Keryn Sylvius
917|1fc2052d.text: Sorry, but I only train rogues.

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

1919-accept.name: Dink
1919-accept.text:
Your knowledge of the craft grows, young $N.  Are you now ready to begin your true lessons?  Are you ready to take your place in the secret war we wage?

If so, then speak with Jennea Cannon, in the wizard's sanctum in the $c district of Stormwind.  She has a task for you which will open your first window into the invisible world.
1919-accept.title: Report to Jennea

1919-complete.name: Jennea Cannon
1919-complete.text: $N, I have a mission for you, here in the $c district.  Listen closely, for there is no time to waste.
1919-complete.title: Report to Jennea

1920-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-accept.text:
A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the $C Quarter.  Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.

I want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures.  Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them.  When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.
1920-accept.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1920-complete.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-complete.text:
Very well done!  I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.

Your value to the society of mages grows, $N.
1920-complete.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1920-progress.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-progress.text: Have you captured the creatures, $N?  They must be studied in order to determine the reason behind their arrival.
1920-progress.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1921-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1921-accept.text:
You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe.  Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials  

The robe will be made of linen which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of Loch Modan, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.

Gather the linen and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the $C District.
1921-accept.title: Gathering Materials

1921-complete.name: Wynne Larson
1921-complete.text: Yes, these are great pieces of linen.  I can make a fine robe with them.  And after I weave the rift gems into it, we'll have a garment fit for a $c!
1921-complete.title: Gathering Materials

1921-progress.name: Wynne Larson
1921-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Jennea told me you would come.  Do you have something for me?
1921-progress.title: Gathering Materials

1941-complete.name: Wynne Larson
1941-complete.text: Here is your robe.  It's one of my best made yet!  Wear it with pride, and when people ask... tell them you got it at the Larson Clothiers!
1941-complete.title: Manaweave Robe

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

7802-progress.name: Mistina Steelshield
7802-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Ironforge for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7802-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92745-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92745-complete.text: Well done, $N. But I fear the source of the poison may lie somewhere else...
92745-complete.title: The State of the Mines

92747-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92747-accept.text:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $N, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747-accept.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92909-progress.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-progress.text: It's a mess out there, $N! Did you collect the parts I need?
92909-progress.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

98423-accept.name: Unknown
98423-accept.text: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423-accept.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding
